build_FCOS_detector: build an FCOS single-stage object detector with backbone, neck, and bbox_head configs
run_FCOS_loss: run the FCOS detector loss computation on a batch of input images and data samples
run_FCOS_predict: run the FCOS detector predict method to get bounding box predictions from input images
run_FCOS_extract_feat: run the FCOS detector extract_feat method to get multi-level features from input images
review_FCOS_init: review the FCOS detector __init__ to understand backbone, neck, and bbox_head initialization
